type: Original social app welcome editorial artwork
goal: Create a refined original raster hero for Koko native iOS welcome screen. This is artwork only, not a phone mockup, no interface, no text.

visual_tone.aesthetic: Contemporary independent magazine campaign, tactile candid portrait photography with art-directed cut-paper composition. Friendly adult social connection, confident and understated.
visual_tone.color_palette: deep forest ink #132A26, pale mint #B9EDCE, warm cream, tiny butter yellow accent
visual_tone.lighting: natural late-afternoon window light, realistic skin texture

centerpiece.description: Two large overlapping elongated photographic windows with very rounded arch ends, subtly rotated in opposite directions. Left window starts near x=3%, y=5%, occupies 58% width and 77% height: an original fictional adult woman aged 28 with short wavy dark hair and a cream t-shirt, close-up candid laughing toward camera, relaxed genuine expression. Right window x=58%, y=12%, width 46%, height 61%: original fictional adult man aged 29 in sage shirt and headphones, smiling in a cozy sunlit room, like a friendly video conversation. A smaller cream-bordered oval portrait cameo of a fictional adult Black woman aged 27 in mint shirt overlaps at x=69%,y=63%, width 23%, friendly face only. Strong change of scale, portrait compositions close and intimate. Photographs have softly rounded arch ends, no rectangular card grid.
centerpiece.decoration: A single delicate mint hand-drawn continuous looping stroke woven behind the portraits, and one tiny butter-yellow abstract four-point sparkle near upper right. Original artwork only; no stock icons, no speech bubble, no emoji.

layout.safe_area: All faces entirely within upper 73% and at least 8% from outer image edges. Lower 20% contains only deep forest ink fading very subtly from the photographic shadows, absolutely no objects; this empty area is for native text. Top and bottom outer edges pure uniform #132A26, sides mostly same. No thick outer margin: portraits large, almost edge to edge.
layout.text: NONE. Do not render letters, words, logo, labels, numbers, status indicators, controls or buttons.
